title: Context is the requirement
caption: Context engineering: deciding what the AI sees, the way requirements decide what a team builds.
label: The board inside the context window, with static and dynamic context beside it

the-claim.title: The claim
the-claim.script: So here is the claim, and I want you to treat it as a claim: context engineering is requirements engineering for agents. What you hand the agent decides the result, in the same way a requirement decides the result for a human team.

the-route.title: The route
the-route.script: The route has four stops. First what the AI sees: think of the context window as the desk the AI works at. Then the two kinds of context, static and dynamic: what you set up before the work starts, and what arrives while it runs. Next then how it goes wrong, and finally how to keep it clean.
